source.title: Feralas Mission IV: Dragon Intelligence
source.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Dream Bough, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at Oneiros. Retrieve an intelligence report from Dreamwarden Sheldryn there and return to me.
source.objective: Gather intelligence from Dreamwarden Sheldryn in the Feralas Nightmare Incursion at the southernmost ruins in Oneiros and return to Field Captain Arunnel.
source.completion: Well done! Your services shall be well rewarded. Perhaps another mission?
